seo.title: Support DOM VIRUS: free games, one maker
seo.description: DOM VIRUS is a one-person, open-source passion project. See what support will pay for and how to help today: play, star, share and report bugs.

sections.heading: Support DOM VIRUS
sections.body: DOM VIRUS is a one-person, open-source passion project: a solo maker shipping roughly a game a week on the side. Every game is free to play, with no ads. Sponsorship and tip links go live soon. Here is how to help today.

sections.heading: Why support matters
body: One person designs, codes, tests and ships every game. There is no studio behind them, no ads and no paywall.
Support turns spare hours into more games, faster fixes and the servers that multiplayer will need.

sections.heading: What support will pay for
body: A move from GitHub Pages to the site's own domain, domvirus.com, behind Cloudflare.
Domains for the family: domvirus.com, its game subdomains and a home for the Fizlet engine.
Servers for multiplayer rooms. Multiplayer is planned, and rooms need a small server that a static host cannot run.

sections.heading: Ways to help today, for free

items.title: Play the games
items.body: Every play counts. Find a cartridge and press start.

items.title: Star the repositories
items.body: Stars help other developers find the games on GitHub.

items.title: Share a game
items.body: Send a game to a friend, or post it where your people hang out.

items.title: Report bugs and ideas
items.body: Every report makes the next release better.

items.title: Contribute
items.body: Every game is open source under MIT. Read the code, suggest a fix or open a pull request.

sections.heading: Sponsorship and tips
body: GitHub Sponsors comes first, for monthly or one-time support through GitHub.
A tip jar, such as Ko-fi or Buy Me a Coffee, follows for one-off thanks.
The links appear on this page as soon as the accounts are live.

items.question: Can I sponsor DOM VIRUS today?
items.answer: Not yet. The sponsorship and tip links appear here once the accounts are live. Until then, a star or a share helps most.

items.question: Where will the money go?
items.answer: Into the plans above: the move to domvirus.com, domains for the family and servers for multiplayer rooms.

items.question: Can I help without money?
items.answer: Yes. Play the games, star the repositories, share a game, report bugs or contribute code.
